ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white/grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white/grey mottling is concentrated on the distal regions of both lobes, creating large, irregular contiguous blobs at the outer edges. The medial section around the fluke notch is primarily solid low-intensity black, with scattered high-intensity focal spots and linear streaks across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an approximate obtuse angle and moderate depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations and irregular peaks are visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, clearly delineated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges of both lobes exhibit a continuous convex sweep from the medial notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters are localized at the distal tips of both lobes and along the visible segments of the leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible, particularly on the right lobe (viewer's right), where multiple parallel and intersecting lines cut across the base pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lobe tips and multiple linear rake mark scars on the ventral surface.
